packageRules.description: Nothing automerges here: every Renovate PR waits for a human to merge it.

Hold wasm-bindgen. hotpath pins it exactly, and the Worker build in hotpath-qa.yml runs a wasm-bindgen-cli of that exact version, from a pinned, checksummed download (the pins are recorded in docs/architecture.md, Build-chain pins). The CLI rejects a Wasm file built by any other wasm-bindgen version, so a Renovate update to the crate alone fails the wasm32 check and takes its whole group with it. It waits under Pending Approval on the Dependency Dashboard instead, for a human to move the crate pin and the CLI pin together. Vulnerability updates are not held: Renovate forces dependencyDashboardApproval off for them, and their PR still needs the CLI pin moved by hand before the wasm32 check passes.
